children: In this article, we’ll discuss web development vs android development. We also highlight the benefits, comparison, and related skills. Start with the foremost basic question to know the web development and android development:
What is web and mobile app development?

Web development is the process related to developing websites for the web (World Wide Web) or an intranet (a private network). This process includes web design, web content development, client-side/server-side scripting, and network security configuration, among other tasks.
Mobile app development is the work involved in developing a mobile app for mobile devices, like personal digital assistants, enterprise digital assistants or mobile phones.
Which is the best app development or web development?

Web apps are less costly to develop than mobile apps. Mobile apps are platform- specific and you need to study Java and XML to develop Android Application. Mobile apps are much faster than web apps, and more advanced in features and functionality.
Is Web development easier than mobile development?

Programming language for Web app development includes JavaScript, CSS and HTML5. Compared to mobile apps, web apps don’t have any standard software development kit. Web apps are easier to develop but they’re much simpler in terms of features.

Pros And Cons of Web Development
Now, we’ll discuss the pros and cons of web development.
• The web development community is extremely collaborative and their developers are solving problems on a daily basis as well as sharing their work open-source.
• Web development features a vast job market and expands every day.
• Web apps are developed with well-known programming languages among IT professionals like HTML and CSS.
• Web development applications aren’t downloaded and installed from app stores like Google Play or Apple’s App Store. A direct free web app link is money-saving.
• Web developers need to stay updated with the newest trends.

• Most web developers need to deal with clients who have no knowledge about websites, they expect a back-end developer to do the work of a front-end developer and the other way around , it can get difficult to make a client understand what they need for his or her website.
